articles.title: Nepal Floods: Teacher's Quick Thinking Saved 1,643 Students as School Was Swept Away
articles.excerpt: Rajendra Dawadi, the 47-year-old headmaster of Tribhuvan Trishuli Secondary School, evacuated 1,643 children in minutes after receiving a warning call about the glacier-triggered flash flood that has killed over 750 people.
articles.image_caption: Image: @reliefweb via X
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Modi Meets Iran's Pezeshkian at SCO Summit Amid US-Iran War
articles.excerpt: The first face-to-face meeting between the two leaders since the outbreak of hostilities comes at a critical moment for regional stability and India's energy security.
articles.image_caption: YouTube / CNN-News18
articles.nri_angle: India's diplomatic balancing act has implications for energy prices, remittance flows from the Gulf, and the safety of millions of Indians working in West Asia.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Rejects Hague Court Ruling on Indus Waters Treaty as 'Illegal'
articles.excerpt: India has dismissed the Permanent Court of Arbitration's latest award on the Kishenganga and Ratle hydroelectric projects, calling the tribunal illegally constituted and its rulings void.
articles.nri_angle: The dispute over the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty highlights the deep freeze in India-Pakistan relations and raises questions about the future of one of the world's oldest water-sharing agreements.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India and Uzbekistan Seal Long-Term Uranium Deal as Modi Elevates Ties
articles.excerpt: PM Modi secures a long-term uranium supply arrangement with Uzbekistan and upgrades the bilateral relationship to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.
articles.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi. India and Uzbekistan signed a long-term uranium supply agreement during Modi's visit to Tashkent, deepening bilateral nuclear energy cooperation.
articles.nri_angle: India's energy security and nuclear power expansion have direct implications for the diaspora watching India's strategic positioning and economic growth.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Federal Judge Blocks Trump's Bid to Move Hush Money Case to Federal Court
articles.excerpt: Judge Hellerstein rules that paying hush money is not covered by presidential immunity, keeping Trump's 34 felony convictions in New York state court.
articles.image_caption: President Donald Trump. A federal judge has blocked his attempt to transfer the New York hush money case to federal court, keeping the proceedings in the state system.
articles.nri_angle: Major U.S. legal and political development that Indian Americans closely follow as it shapes the political landscape ahead of future elections.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: China Removes General Who Commanded Forces at Doklam and Galwan
articles.excerpt: General Zhao Zongqi, who reportedly authorized the 2020 Galwan operation to 'teach India a lesson,' has been expelled from China's top political advisory body as Xi Jinping's military purge widens.
articles.image_caption: General Zhao Zongqi, former commander of the PLA's Western Theatre Command. Zhao oversaw Chinese forces during the 2017 Doklam standoff and the 2020 Galwan Valley clash with India.
articles.nri_angle: The Doklam and Galwan confrontations were widely followed by the Indian diaspora. Zhao Zongqi's removal deepens instability in the PLA command overseeing India's border, raising strategic questions about military posture along the LAC.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India Express Pilots Challenge Revised Pay Structure Over Income Uncertainty and Leave Cuts
articles.excerpt: Despite higher headline earnings and fleet allowances, Air India Express pilots say the new compensation framework shifts rostering risk onto crews and effectively penalizes them for taking leave.
articles.image_caption: An Air India Express Boeing 737 on the tarmac. Pilots at the Tata Group-owned budget carrier have raised concerns over a revised pay structure that ties income to monthly flying hours.
articles.nri_angle: Air India Express is a key carrier for diaspora travel between India and the Gulf, and labor disputes could affect flight frequency and service quality on routes heavily used by NRIs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India Seeks $1.5 Billion in Fresh Equity From Tata Sons and Singapore Airlines as Losses Mount
articles.excerpt: The carrier's combined FY26 losses topped $2.3 billion, drawing political scrutiny in Singapore and raising questions about the decade-long turnaround timeline.
articles.image_caption: An Air India aircraft. The Tata Group-owned airline is seeking 1.5 billion dollars in fresh equity from Tata Sons and Singapore Airlines as losses mount during its integration process.
articles.nri_angle: Air India's financial health directly affects service quality and connectivity for the millions of NRIs who depend on it for US-India travel.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Homegrown CAR-T Cell Therapies Are Reshaping Blood Cancer Treatment
articles.excerpt: With two approved indigenous CAR-T therapies and over 600 patients treated, India has emerged as a global hub for affordable cell and gene therapy — at one-tenth the cost of Western alternatives.
articles.image_caption: A laboratory setup for CAR-T cell therapy processing. India now has two approved indigenous CAR-T therapies that are reshaping blood cancer treatment at a fraction of the global cost.
articles.nri_angle: India's affordable CAR-T therapies offer a lifeline for diaspora families whose relatives face blood cancer diagnoses back home, with treatment costs a fraction of what U.S. hospitals charge.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Orders Wind Turbine Makers to Store All Data Locally Amid Rising Cyberattack Threats
articles.excerpt: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy mandates data localisation, domestic operational control, and in-country R&D centres for all ALMM-listed wind turbine manufacturers.
articles.image_caption: Wind turbines in India. The government has ordered all wind turbine manufacturers to store operational data locally amid rising cybersecurity threats.
articles.nri_angle: India's push for energy infrastructure data localisation reflects broader cybersecurity trends affecting global renewable energy companies, including those with Indian-origin engineers and executives.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bomb Blast at Manipur BJP MLA's Residence Condemned as 'Attack on Democracy'
articles.excerpt: An explosive device detonated at the Imphal home of BJP MLA Sapam Ranjan Singh in the early hours of Friday, with the chief minister calling it a 'senseless and barbaric' attack.
articles.image_caption: The site of a bomb blast at a BJP MLA residence in Imphal, Manipur. The attack has been condemned as an assault on democracy amid ongoing unrest in the northeastern state.
articles.nri_angle: The security situation in Manipur remains a concern for the Indian diaspora, particularly those from the northeast, as violence against elected representatives signals continued instability.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Federal Judge Declines to Block Trump's New Birthright Citizenship Order but Questions Its Viability
articles.excerpt: U.S. District Judge Deborah Boardman rejected a temporary restraining order on procedural grounds but sharply questioned whether Trump's August executive order targeting birth tourism could survive legal challenge after the Supreme Court's sweeping June ruling.
articles.image_caption: The 14th Amendment to the US Constitution, which guarantees birthright citizenship. A federal judge declined to block Trump's new executive order targeting it.
articles.nri_angle: Birthright citizenship is fundamental to Indian-origin families on work visas whose U.S.-born children are citizens; the legal uncertainty around Trump's orders affects the diaspora directly.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Trump Signs New Birthright Citizenship Orders Targeting Birth Tourism After Supreme Court Loss
articles.excerpt: A pair of executive orders narrow who qualifies for automatic citizenship, weeks after the Supreme Court affirmed the 14th Amendment right in a landmark 6-3 ruling.
articles.image_caption: President Donald Trump. He has signed new executive orders targeting birth tourism after losing a Supreme Court challenge on birthright citizenship.
articles.nri_angle: The ongoing legal battle over birthright citizenship directly affects Indian-origin families on temporary work visas whose children were born on U.S. soil.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: U.S. Navy Blockade Cuts Iran Oil Exports by 90% as Washington Escalates Economic War
articles.excerpt: Iran's crude output has plunged to 259,000 barrels per day as the UAE suspends all trade with Tehran and Treasury freezes $500 billion in crypto assets
articles.image_caption: A US Navy warship. The Navy's blockade has cut Iran's oil exports by 90 percent as Washington escalates its economic campaign against Tehran.
articles.nri_angle: Rising crude prices from the Iran blockade are pressuring India's trade deficit and the rupee, directly affecting NRI investments and the cost of living for families in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Hits 538 as Barrier Lake Threatens Fresh Devastation
articles.excerpt: Nearly 1,000 remain missing including 98 Indians, while Kathmandu declines foreign search-and-rescue teams and a debris-dammed lake on the Tibet border begins to overflow.
articles.nri_angle: 98 Indian nationals remain missing and 85 have been rescued; India sent 50 metric tons of relief supplies but Nepal declined its offer of search-and-rescue teams.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Signs Deal to Buy US-Made Javelin Anti-Tank Missile Systems
articles.excerpt: The Indian Army will acquire the battle-tested fire-and-forget missile system under a deal that deepens a defense partnership unshaken by recent trade tensions between Washington and New Delhi.
articles.nri_angle: The deepening India-US defense partnership strengthens strategic ties that benefit the broader Indian-American community and diaspora interests in both countries.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Modi to Meet Putin at SCO Summit in First Bilateral Since December
articles.excerpt: India's PM begins a two-nation Central Asia tour Saturday, with bilateral meetings lined up alongside Putin and Xi Jinping at the 25th-anniversary SCO summit.
articles.image_caption: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. He is set to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin at the SCO Summit in his first bilateral with the Russian leader since December.
articles.nri_angle: Modi's diplomatic engagements with Putin and Xi at the SCO summit set the stage for India's BRICS hosting in September, with implications for energy, defense, and trade relationships watched closely by the diaspora business community.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nepal, China Warn of Fresh Flood Risks as Barrier Lakes Threaten to Burst
articles.excerpt: Two debris-dammed lakes on either side of the border risk collapse as nearly 1,000 people remain missing from this week's catastrophic glacier flood.
articles.image_caption: Flood damage in Nepal. Authorities in Nepal and China have warned of fresh flood risks as barrier lakes formed by landslides threaten to burst.
articles.nri_angle: At least 288 Indian nationals remain missing in Nepal, with many on pilgrimage to Mount Kailash. Indian embassies and state governments have set up helplines for families across Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Andhra Pradesh.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: FDA Approves Updated COVID-19 Vaccines for 2026-27 Season
articles.excerpt: Four shots from Moderna, Pfizer-BioNTech, and Novavax-Sanofi cleared for older adults and high-risk individuals as fall vaccination campaign prepares to launch.
articles.nri_angle: Updated vaccines particularly relevant for Indian Americans, especially older adults and those with chronic conditions like diabetes and heart disease that are more prevalent in South Asian populations.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Death Penalty Sought for Man Who Killed Tennessee Store Owner Suresh Patel
articles.excerpt: Prosecutors in Tennessee are seeking the death penalty against Corey Houge, charged in the fatal shootings of Indian-origin grocery store owner Suresh Patel and Bangladeshi gas station worker Shahed Rana Mohsin during a multi-county crime spree.
articles.image_caption: Hamilton County Courthouse in Chattanooga, Tennessee. Prosecutors are seeking the death penalty for the man charged with killing store owner Suresh Patel.
articles.nri_angle: The fatal shooting of Indian-origin store owner Suresh Patel during an armed robbery in Tennessee highlights the risks faced by South Asian small business owners across the United States.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Surges Past 330 as Glacier Collapse Scale Becomes Clear
articles.excerpt: Scientists confirm an ice-rock avalanche, not an earthquake, triggered one of Nepal's worst natural disasters, with over 900 people still missing including dozens of Americans and 177 Indian pilgrims.
articles.image_caption: An aerial view shows houses buried under mud and debris following flash floods in Nepal on August 26, 2026. The floods killed over 330 people and left more than 900 missing across eight districts.
articles.nri_angle: 177 Indian pilgrims en route to Kailash Mansarovar are among the missing, 63 Americans unaccounted for, and downstream flooding prompted evacuations in Bihar — the disaster has direct implications for diaspora families across South Asia.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Third Explosive Drone Found Near Leipzig Airport as Europe Confronts Russian Hybrid Warfare
articles.excerpt: U.S. intelligence links the attack to Russian military intelligence after an armed drone was discovered near a Ukrainian cargo plane carrying ammunition at a key NATO logistics hub.
articles.image_caption: Leipzig/Halle Airport in Germany, where a third explosive drone device was found amid escalating concerns over Russian hybrid warfare targeting European infrastructure.
articles.nri_angle: The escalating pattern of hybrid attacks on European transportation infrastructure raises security concerns for Indian diaspora travelers and businesses operating across the continent.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Death Toll Rises to 160 in Nepal Flood as 133 Indian Pilgrims Remain Missing
articles.excerpt: At least 57 Tamil Nadu pilgrims stranded in Rasuwa as rescue operations struggle with destroyed bridges, roads, and adverse weather across the Himalayan border region.
articles.image_caption: Rescue operations continue in Nepal after devastating floods that have killed at least 160 people, with 133 Indian pilgrims still missing.
articles.nri_angle: Over 133 Indian nationals, many on pilgrimage to Mount Kailash, are among hundreds missing after the catastrophic flood; 57 Tamil Nadu pilgrims remain stranded.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: FDA Approves First RAS-Targeted Drug for Pancreatic Cancer After Trial Nearly Doubles Survival
articles.excerpt: Daraxonrasib, sold as Rasonque, is a once-daily pill that extended median survival to 13.2 months from 6.7 months on chemotherapy in a phase 3 trial of 500 patients.
articles.image_caption: The FDA has approved the first RAS-targeted drug for pancreatic cancer after a clinical trial nearly doubled patient survival rates.
articles.nri_angle: The approval opens a new treatment option for pancreatic cancer patients worldwide, including in the Indian-American community where gastrointestinal cancers carry significant health burden.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Meta Agrees to Pay $18 Billion and Overhaul Teen Safety in Landmark Settlement With 47 States
articles.excerpt: The largest tech settlement in history ends a trial over youth social media addiction, requiring daily time limits, night mode, and hidden like counts for minors on Facebook and Instagram.
articles.image_caption: Meta has agreed to pay approximately $18 billion in a landmark settlement with 47 US states over teen safety concerns on its social media platforms.
articles.nri_angle: The settlement could reshape how Indian-American families manage their children's social media use, with mandatory time limits and parental controls becoming default on Meta's platforms.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US-Canada Trade War Escalates as Talks Collapse and New Tariffs Bite Both Economies
articles.excerpt: Ontario's Doug Ford backs retaliatory tariffs and floats cutting electricity to US states as Canada braces for sweeping new American duties.
articles.image_caption: The US-Canada trade war has intensified after bilateral talks collapsed, with new tariffs threatening both economies.
articles.nri_angle: The trade conflict threatens to raise consumer prices on both sides of the border and could affect Indian-Canadian businesses with cross-border supply chains.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Two Unvaccinated Pennsylvanians Die of Measles in First US Deaths This Year
articles.excerpt: Lancaster County deaths mark Pennsylvania's first measles fatalities in 35 years as the US endures its worst outbreak since 1991 with nearly 2,800 cases.
articles.image_caption: Two unvaccinated Pennsylvania residents have died of measles, marking the first US measles deaths this year amid ongoing outbreaks.
articles.nri_angle: With school starting across the US, Indian-American families should verify their children's MMR vaccination status, as 94% of measles cases involve unvaccinated individuals.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: UPI Turns 10: India's Digital Payment System Logs 12,000-Fold Growth in a Decade
articles.excerpt: From 2 crore transactions in its first year to over 24,000 crore in FY 2025-26, UPI now accounts for 49% of global real-time payments.
articles.nri_angle: UPI now operates in the UAE, Singapore, and several other countries, directly benefiting NRIs sending remittances and traveling between India and their countries of residence.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Hundreds Missing After Glacier Collapse Triggers Catastrophic Flood on Nepal-Tibet Border
articles.excerpt: At least 95 dead and more than 480 travelers unaccounted for, including over 100 Indians, after a wall of mud and rock devastated the Himalayan border region.
articles.image_caption: A catastrophic flood triggered by a glacier collapse has devastated communities along the Nepal-Tibet border, leaving hundreds of people missing.
articles.nri_angle: More than 100 Indian nationals are among the missing travelers, and flood alerts have been issued in the Indian border states of Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's AI and Data Centre Ambitions Face a Power Infrastructure Reckoning
articles.excerpt: With nearly $300 billion committed and capacity quadrupling in six years, India's data centre build-out confronts grid instability, copper shortages, and the absence of environmental regulation.
articles.image_caption: Rows of servers inside an Indian data centre facility. India's live IT capacity has quadrupled to 1.7 GW in six years, making it the largest data centre market in Asia-Pacific outside China.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American tech executives at Google, Microsoft, and Amazon are shaping data centre investment decisions while NRI investors weigh commercial opportunity against infrastructure risks.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Israel Escalates Gaza Strikes, Warns Hamas Over Kite and Drone Launches
articles.excerpt: Two airstrikes killed at least two people including a four-year-old boy on Sunday, as Israel threatened to intensify operations in Gaza over projectile launches despite the October 2025 ceasefire.
articles.image_caption: Israel has intensified military operations in the Gaza Strip, issuing new warnings to Hamas over kite and drone launches from the territory.
articles.nri_angle: Thousands of Indian workers remain in Israel, and the Indian government has maintained close diplomatic ties with both Israel and Palestine, making the conflict's trajectory directly relevant to Indian foreign policy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Four Arrested After 18 Elephants Die in Kenya's Amboseli Ecosystem
articles.excerpt: Kenyan authorities seized chemicals and detained four suspects as investigations into suspected cyanide poisoning of elephants near Amboseli National Park deepened.
articles.image_caption: Elephants in Kenya's Amboseli ecosystem. Four suspects have been arrested after 18 elephants were found dead from suspected cyanide poisoning since late June.
articles.nri_angle: Kenya is home to a significant Indian-origin community of over 100,000 people, many of whom are involved in business and tourism sectors directly connected to wildlife conservation and safari tourism.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Syria's 'Barrel Bomb Mufti' Sentenced to Life for War Crimes
articles.excerpt: Ahmad Badreddin Hassoun, Syria's former Grand Mufti who provided religious cover for the Assad regime's atrocities, was convicted after a six-day trial in Damascus.
articles.nri_angle: The Syrian transitional justice process carries significance for the Indian diaspora, with India historically maintaining diplomatic ties with Syria and a small Indian community in the region affected by the civil war's fallout.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: World Ocean Temperatures Shatter Records as El Niño Threatens Uncharted Heat
articles.excerpt: Sea surface temperatures hit historic highs in June and July 2026, with scientists warning that a potentially record-breaking El Niño could push the planet into unprecedented warming territory.
articles.image_caption: Global ocean temperatures have surged to record levels in 2026, with scientists warning that a developing El Niño could push sea surface heat into uncharted territory.
articles.nri_angle: Rising ocean temperatures and a strengthening El Niño directly affect the Indian monsoon cycle, with implications for agriculture, water resources, and extreme weather events across the Indian subcontinent.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nvidia AI Chip Found Inside Russian Stealth Missile, Exposing Sanctions Gaps
articles.excerpt: Ukrainian intelligence recovered a Jetson Orin module from a downed S-71M cruise missile, raising fresh questions about export controls and the militarization of commercial AI hardware.
articles.image_caption: An Nvidia graphics processing unit. A disassembled Russian cruise missile was found to contain an Nvidia AI chip, exposing gaps in Western sanctions enforcement.
articles.nri_angle: Nvidia, led by CEO Jensen Huang, employs thousands of Indian-American engineers and the sanctions evasion issue has implications for the broader U.S. tech industry where Indian-Americans hold significant leadership roles.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
